canada.title: Your questions about this year's federal budget, answered
canada.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's government unveiled a budget Thursday that covered more than $150 billion in spending, detailed in a 500-plus-page document. As Canadians attempt to parse what the budget means for them, here are answers to some of the questions sent in by CBC readers, viewers and listeners.

canada.title: RNC investigate several hit-and-runs in Torbay in one night
canada.summary: After an eventful evening in Torbay that ended in five vehicles being towed, the Royal Newfoundland Constabulary is looking for two drivers thought to be involved in multiple hit-and-runs Thursday night.

canada.title: ‘Devil in the detail’ for how Ottawa’s budget could help long term: MUN economist
canada.summary: Ottawa has released a new budget and MUN economist Lynn Gambin says it could be good news for Newfoundland and Labrador, but it will come down to how it's implemented.

canada.title: Landslide risk prompts evacuation order for village of Zeballos on Vancouver Island
canada.summary: A state of local emergency and an evacuation order have been issued for Zeballos, a village of about 125 people on the northwest coast of Vancouver Island, due to flooding and potential landslide risks.

canada.title: Joly asks Comp Bureau to probe Stelco deal after CEO comments
canada.summary: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly is asking the Competition Bureau to examine whether Cleveland-Cliffs’ rationale for acquiring Stelco Inc. was conducted in bad faith.

canada.title: Wind warnings issued for communities across Alberta
canada.summary: A fierce windstorm is expected to whip across a swath of Alberta communities on Friday, making for a blustery start to the weekend.

canada.title: B.C. bucks national trend, adding over 12K jobs in October: StatsCan
canada.summary: British Columbia gained 12,300 jobs in October, according to Statistics Canada's latest Labour Force Survey.

canada.title: With some concerns from MLAs, N.W.T.'s SCAN and civil forfeiture laws await assent
canada.summary: While two pieces of legislation are on the cusp of turning into law, one is still raising red flags for some MLAs.

canada.title: Crown withdraws charges in case of alleged scallop fishing violations
canada.summary: The matter had been set for trial in December, but during a court appearance in September the Crown said that after an ongoing review it was determined there was no longer a realistic prospect of conviction.

canada.title: Winnipeg addictions and mental health centre promised in budget could be running in 3 years
canada.summary: A multimillion-dollar federal funding commitment to create a new Winnipeg facility for mental health and addictions care represents a "massive opportunity" for the city and the province, Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says.

canada.title: Crown drops 38 charges against Moncton man without explanation
canada.summary: All charges have been dropped against a Moncton man in a case RCMP described as stemming from a months-long, complex investigation.

canada.title: 2 Lévis, Que., police officers suspended with pay, but allegations remain unclear
canada.summary: Two police officers from the Service de police de la Ville de Lévis (SPVL) have been suspended with pay following an internal investigation.

canada.title: Gretzky backs Carney’s Russian world junior ban
canada.summary: Wayne Gretzky says he backs Canada's decision to bar Russia from the upcoming world junior hockey championship in Alberta.

canada.title: Hydro-Québec to buy land intended for failed Northvolt electric vehicle battery plant
canada.summary: Hydro-Québec says it has reached an agreement to acquire an 18-million-square-foot parcel of land that was expected to house the failed Northvolt electric vehicle battery plant.

canada.title: Woman dead, man arrested after stabbing in North York: Toronto police
canada.summary: Toronto police are investigating a homicide after a woman died in a stabbing in North York Friday morning.

canada.title: Manitoba Métis Federation ‘appalled’ by being left out of budget
canada.summary: The president of the Manitoba Métis Federation says he's 'appalled' that Métis were not included in the federal budget.

canada.title: Nova Scotia chooses 2026 Boston Christmas tree from East Amherst
canada.summary: A 14-metre white spruce from Nova Scotia will soon be cut and shipped to Boston as an annual Christmas gift to thank the city for its help after the Halifax Explosion.

canada.title: Indian Act controversy lingers more than a week after abolishment was raised in Ottawa
canada.summary: Everyone has been hashing out just what it could mean to abolish the Indian Act after it was raised by Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew in Ottawa.

canada.title: Disbarred former Manitoba law dean loses extradition fight in French Appeal Court
canada.summary: A document from the Versailles Court of Appeal says the Indictment Division has granted Canada's request to extradite the man. No transfer date was given.

lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

President Donald Trump said Friday that Stephen Miller was replacing Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff, mere days after Republicans lost control of Congress in the midterm elections, The Associated Press reports.

The 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, was arrested Friday morning in Florida on a charge of possessing child sexual abuse material in storage units in California, authorities said.
Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy released from hospital after stroke, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
